subject: Agriculture
title: Water Table Collapse
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Water Table Collapse.

hook.text: Punjab's water table is dropping 1 meter per year. Rice paddies are drinking the aquifer dry.

buildup.text: Green Revolution rice in Punjab requires flooding fields for months. It was never meant for this climate.

discovery.text: Free electricity for pumps means farmers pay nothing to extract groundwater. There's no incentive to conserve.

twist.text: Some wells now reach 200 meters deep. Each year, pumps must work harder to pull water from lower aquifers.

climax.text: Scientists warn Punjab's groundwater could be functionally depleted within 25 years at current rates.

punchline.text: The Green Revolution quenched hunger but drained the wells.

quiz.question: How fast is Punjab's water table dropping?
